card.name: Just before the word clearance
card.fires_on: The word or mark right before the word "clearance" (drug clearance) in pharmacokinetic interaction text, such as "decrease in", "the renal", or a decimal point before a clearance value.

modes.label: Linking word before clearance
modes.description: A small word such as in, the, or renal that comes after a decrease or increase and leads into clearance.
modes.example: with a corresponding decrease<< in>> clearance.

modes.label: Drug name or bracket before clearance
modes.description: The end of a drug name or an opening bracket right before clearance.
modes.example: resulted in a 42% decrease in propranol<<ol>> clearance.

modes.label: Decimal point in a clearance value
modes.description: The point in a number that gives a clearance value.
modes.example: increased ketoprofen plasma clearance from 0<<.>>07 L/kg/h without aspirin

card.writes: It pushes toward a word that continues the phrase, and away from the word rate in forms like clearance rate.
card.plain: It fires when the next word is likely to be "clearance" in a drug-interaction sentence.
